1-800 WATER DAMAGE Partnerships


Teaming With Elite Professionals To Provide Superior Services

We are premier partners with various professionals, including insurance adjusters, plumbers, property management companies, realtors, and more. Additionally, we are a member of the BELFOR Franchise Group, an internationally renowned restoration company. We are committed to restoring what matters most to our clients. Partnerships with us help the entire restoration process take place smoothly and correctly the first time.

Insurance Adjustment

We are the team many adjusters refer throughout the country to their policyholders after significant damage to homes or business. 1-800 WATER DAMAGE has a solid reputation amongst insurance companies and adjusters for being reliable, honest, and hardworking. Committed to full transparency, we’re upfront with our pricing, the services a client needs, and how we plan to address the issues. This way, all involved parties can make informed decisions. Additionally, our professionals work quickly and efficiently to minimize the damage and prevent it from getting worse.

Property Management

When you manage a multi-unit property, you have enough to worry about. Not only are you responsible for the daily tasks around the property, but you’re also responsible for adhering to health and safety codes. If you manage condos, apartment complexes, commercial office buildings, and more, we’re the partner to trust. We work with managers of commercial, single and multiple-family residential properties to provide restoration services for tenants.

Real Estate 

Many real estate agencies enlist our services for the purpose of renovating a home in one of the many ways in which we specialize. We work hard to provide mitigation and restoration services to ensure homes and properties are up to code and are safe to occupy.

Plumbing 

Traditional plumbing services often see properties with profound water damage and septic flooding; we are called in to effectively restore these properties. We believe in forging valuable partnerships between other professionals to ensure the client receives the best care possible. That is why we work with a variety of different plumbers to address issues such as mold growth, water damage, fire damage, sewage backup, and other disasters.

Let’s Partner Together

In addition to providing exceptional restoration services for our clients’ homes and businesses, we seek to work with only trusted, respectable professionals. Whether you are a plumber experiencing a sewage backup, or an insurance adjuster evaluating property damage, we want to explore a partnership with you to best serve the needs of home and business owners currently experiencing significant damage.

Learn More

To learn more about our professional partnerships, call (800) 928-3732.
